splitRule: all variants of a base problem remain in one split
privateFactRule: controller only; disclose only authorized answers to targeted questions
missingScores: retain unknown; never score solver optimal as original-task correct
failures: retain all attempts, cancellation and unknown outcomes
falsification: fewer questions with more wrong stopping
claimBoundary: mock trajectories and offline mathematics are engineering evidence, not model-performance evidence
scoringDenominator: all attempted tasks; incomplete tasks are unsuccessful; completed ungraded tasks define descriptive lower/upper bounds
budgetReplyUnitPolicy: Explicit amount units must match the frozen budget unit before evidence reuse; conflicting currencies pause without new provider or solver calls. No currency conversion.

conversationPolicy.multipleAnswers: each resolved gap requires newly anchored replacement evidence
conversationPolicy.budgetCorrections: explicit revisions enter current modeling and review; simple unambiguous matching-unit answers may reuse evidence
conversationPolicy.solverReuse: same mathematics after current validation and numerical recheck; record source run and current candidate
